title: relay_queue dead-letter move block is duplicated twice within try_deliver_one
description: In relay_queue.rs try_deliver_one, the block that moves env_path and msg_path to dead/ appears twice: once after a DKIM signing failure (lines 307-319) and once after a permanent delivery failure (lines 363-378). The two blocks are structurally identical. Suggested rewrite: extract async fn move_to_dead(env_path, msg_path, dead_dir) -> () and call it from both sites. This also ensures any future fix to the move logic (e.g. logging a dead-letter reason) is applied consistently.
